entry.title: Freedom Planet 2 v1.0.0r2
entry.content:
Changes since Prerelease 1:
**FIXES**
- Items with multiple classifications are now properly coloured in the text chat and display the most relevant sprite type. (Initially became a problem with Perfect Dark, which has a lot of items tagged as both Progression and Useful). - Hopefully finally stomped out the issue where modded items caused the end of the shops to fall apart. - Fixed the Spam Trap getting stuck when changing scenes. - RingLink had some weirdness regarding activating when it shouldn't that should be fixed at this point.
**ADDITIONS**
- Added a config option for whether or not Fists of Frogs should send hints out. - Silly little config option for the shop vendor names. - A, S and Rainbow S-Rank locations. - Merga Goal option. - Wordle and Flood Traps. - Stupid joke config option that makes various bits of text behave like they do in Super Mario 64 (which has missing characters be replaced by the previous one). - Games without a DeathLink message now display jokes/references rather than just "DeathLink received from [PLAYER]".
**ADJUSTMENTS**
- Changed the stage edits made to Sky Bridge. - Spike Ball Trap now specifically spawns on the screen edges rather than a fixed distance from the player.
**KNOWN ISSUES**
- The Trivia Trap still can't kill the BFF2000 or Bakunawa Chase Airship properly. - Swap Traps can still sometimes leave a lingering hitbox on the player. - Fists of Frog's hint sending is still really picky. - The Remote Player handler still seems to freeze the game upon close if active, requiring it to be force killed (still thinking about just throwing that out to be honest). - Game still seems to crash a lot, seemingly at random. The randomness paired with the fact that I can't strap a debugger to it makes diagnosing these a pain.

entry.title: Build a Jetpack v0.3.0b0

Improved the title screen
Added music shuffle, which can be toggled through the PICO-8 pause menu. As this is entirely client-side, a new random track will be picked every time the music changes. entry.title: Wikipelago v1.1.1
entry.content:
## Main changes
- **Realm Master mode: Realms only require their Portal.** No more reaching a crossroad on the main road first. Grand Goal games are unchanged (Portal + crossroad). - **Universal Tracker support.** UT should now behave correctly and not display unavailable Branch paths. - **Rerolls and Backs are saved.** Used Rerolls and Backs survive reconnects and switching devices. - **YAML option sections.** Options are sorted into a few categories in the Launcher's Options Creator for better readability.
## Improvements
- Once the main road is done, it says "Main road cleared" instead of showing the last target. - Reduced Wikipedia requests per click. - Article filter adjustments, and "List of…" pages are filtered in all 9 languages. - Some Wikipedia info tables no longer show bright blue headers and now match the theme. - The top banner can be hidden (it comes back next visit). - Keyboard focus no longer jumps away, pop-up windows keep focus, light-theme grey text is easier to read, and loading animations respect the "reduce motion" system setting. - The phone layout and the Journey window are now documented. - Added a broadcast system, mostly to warn about incoming server restart.
## Bug fixes
- The click count could carry over between slots, or between Practice and a room. - Browser Back was blocked after disconnecting; holding Backspace could spend several Backs. - A failed teleport showed its error twice; Disconnect showed two notices.
## For hosts and players
- **Archipelago 0.6.7 or newer.** - Games generated with 1.x keep working on the updated site, with their old rules. - `random_goal_article` and `goal_article_preset` are removed. Older YAMLs that still contain them generate fine; Archipelago just logs a warning. The new YAML template requires the 1.1.1 apworld. - Bugs: [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Dreskn/Wikipelago-Continued/issues) or [Discord](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1462007968902938768).

entry.title: Sly 2: Band of Thieves v1.1.1
entry.content:
Sly 2 Archipelago implementation. For setup instructions, check out the [README](https://github.com/NikolajDanger/APSly2/blob/main/README.md).
## Changes ### Features - ThiefNet looks super cool now! Items have icons and colored text based on their item class. These can be changed or turned off with the new `/thiefnet_theme` and `/thiefnet_text` commands, and your choice is saved in the game. - The notification bar now also shows up in non-hub areas. - Receiving a DeathLink now plays an actual death animation, with a random type of death. - Receiving coins plays the coin sound, and the Noise trap now sounds an alarm. - Randomized pickpocket loot from other episodes is no longer invisible. - Pressing Start on the title screen is disabled, preventing accidental loading of the wrong save. - The spoiler log now includes the slot name and any options that were changed by `permissive_yaml`.
### Bug fixes and improvements - Slightly better looking tracker maps. - More optimized PCSX2 communication (batching, caching, faster bulk transfers). - Fixed a crash when a Slow-mo or Sugar Rush trap ended during a pickpocket. - Fixed the notification bar sometimes getting stuck on screen. For real this time!! - Fixed Mega Jump getting unbound from Sly's buttons. - The Mega Jump pack in episode 8 no longer shows up or blocks treasures from being picked up. This was technically a softlock possibility that no one has ever run into. - Fixed a vanilla bug where finished jobs could be started again (the sawmill bug). - The vault marker now only shows up when the vault is actually available. - Fixed ThiefNet sometimes not updating after loading into a level. - Fixed guards keeping their vanilla pickpocket loot if they spawned before the client connected. I've lost count of how many times I've fixed this one. - Fixed the goal operations in the tracker map. - Connecting the client while the game is still booting no longer breaks the boot. - Removed the `/trace` command. When PCSX2 crashes, the client now logs crash info by itself.

entry.title: Slay the Spire II v1.2.0
entry.content:
> [!WARNING] > Both Slay the Spire II and this Archipelago Mod are in active development. As such, while this _is_ playable, expect there to be bugs and limited features. We appreciate your playtesting! ## Setup For installation, YAML configuration, generation and connection instructions, see [the Slay the Spire II setup guide](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/blob/setup-docs-do-not-delete/world/spire2/docs/setup_en.md). Archipelago **Launcher v0.6.7+** is required for generation. Install **STS2-RitsuLib 0.6.0+** separately. # Version Information - **Archipelago Client:** 2.0.0 - **APWorld:** 1.2.0 - **Slay the Spire II main branch:** v0.107.1 - **Slay the Spire II beta branch:** v0.111.0 # Changelist ## Major changes ### Multiplayer You can now play Archipelago in co-op! Connect using your own AP slot and YAML, or join as a guest without an AP slot. The host needs an AP connection. This required @Terairk to rewrite the mod side code as StS2 does multiplayer in a very specific deterministic way which meant rewriting everything. Some behaviour may or may not be intentionally changed from previous mod versions to allow multiplayer to even exist. Future updates will take longer as multiplayer is very complicated and some future updates may or may not work on multiplayer. Most of your favourite singleplayer features are supported, with a few exceptions: - **AP menu rewards can only be claimed outside combat, including potions.** This is a limitation of how Slay the Spire 2 handles multiplayer rewards. Working around it would require substantial changes and is not planned for the foreseeable future. You cannot stockpile unclaimed AP potion rewards and withdraw them during the Act 3 boss fight—claim the potions you want before entering combat. - **DeathLink is supported, but Death Fragments are disabled in multiplayer due to state divergences.** - **Anytime Ancient rewards are recommended for multiplayer.** In Start of Act mode, Ancient rewards missed before a checkpoint cannot be claimed later in that run. ### Traps Added **nine trap types** for singleplayer and multiplayer: Weak, Frail, Vulnerable, No Draw, Tangled, Vakuu, Confused, Sloth, and Dazed. Future traps may or may not work in multiplayer due to state divergences or balance concerns in multiplayer. Traps are **disabled by default**. Set **`trap_chance`** to give filler items a chance of being replaced by a trap, then adjust each trap's weight to choose which ones can appear and how often. Received traps wait for combat, with **at most one trap activating per player turn**. They have their own queue, so receiving a trap does not use up your combat buff allowance. ### Filler and combat buff rework Combat buffs now activate **at most once per player per combat**, in both singleplayer and multiplayer. Extra buffs stay queued for later combats instead of all being consumed at once. This is to handle the weird case where you log into the game again (like if you took a break or juggling multiplayer games) only for 20 buffs to be consumed and also prevents the bad handling where some buffs were unable to be stacked properly. Strength, Dexterity, and Artifact buffs now grant **1 instead of 2**, and Plating grants **4 instead of 5**. Vigor, Thorns, Friendship, and permanent deck effects keep their existing strengths. The idea is that buffs should only be worth roughly 1 relic of help and shouldn't boost the player too much otherwise they can go out of logic even easier than it already is. ### More flexible randomization Added the YAML option **`use_new_logic`**, enabled by default. The new logic considers your overall strength more flexibly. For example, extra cards and relics can let you progress where the old logic would require another Progressive Rest. This approach applies across more of your upgrades, allowing greater variety in which items arrive early and which combinations let you advance. Basically allows more randomness and variety. May or may not be harder than the old logic. ### Better saves and checkpoints - Choose from **nine singleplayer checkpoint positions per character**, including new pre-boss campfire checkpoints in all three acts. - Manage multiple multiplayer campaigns, with separate **Floor Recovery** and **AP Checkpoint** loading options. - Singleplayer checkpoints are stored locally by default. **AP Server Cloud Saves** remain available as an optional setting, disabled by default, so you can keep remote backups without every player automatically adding large saves to the AP server’s storage. ### Version compatibility **Development and gameplay testing have been on beta `0.111.0`.** A build for main `0.107.1` is included, but if you encounter problems there, please switch to `0.111.0`. Existing YAMLs do not need the new per-character starter fields: omitted settings inherit their global settings. Use the updated APWorld and client for **traps and per-character progressive starter overrides**. Older clients do not support the new trap items, and older APWorlds reject the new per-character starter fields when they are explicitly included in a YAML. New predefined-character aliases and expanded rosters also require the updated APWorld. ---
Full details ### Saves and checkpoints - The singleplayer checkpoint picker lets you start a new run or load a previously reached checkpoint. - Checkpoints cover the initial Ancient, each act’s treasure room and pre-boss campfire, and the defeated Act 1 and Act 2 bosses. - Starting a new run preserves existing checkpoints until you reach and overwrite their corresponding positions. - AP checkpoints are stored separately for each slot and character, independently of ordinary game saves. - Enabling **AP Server Cloud Saves** backs up the latest eligible singleplayer checkpoint for each character and enables **Load Remote Save**. - The multiplayer campaign picker includes campaign history, archiving, abandonment, and deletion controls. - Added **Local Save Management** settings for deleting AP singleplayer checkpoints or multiplayer campaigns. ### Logic and generation - Set **`use_new_logic: false`** in your YAML to use the previous logic. - New logic allows base-game characters to progress without their starter card or relic when other rewards provide enough support. - **Start of Act** mode still requires the corresponding Ancient unlocks for later acts. - When floor, gold, and potion checks are all disabled, generation automatically uses old logic to reduce generation failures. - Improved early item placement for configurations with fewer checks. - Fixed an Act 3 shop-access logic issue. - Rare Card Rewards receive normal progression placement priority. - Elite and Boss Gold are treated as useful rewards rather than required progression when new logic is active and Shop Sanity is disabled. ### Traps and filler rewards - **`trap_chance`** ranges from 0–100 and defaults to 0. It controls the chance of replacing a filler item, without adding extra items or checks. - Each trap has a **None / Low / Medium / High** weight. None excludes that trap; enabling traps with every trap weight set to None produces a clear configuration error. - Weak, Frail, and Vulnerable apply one turn of their respective debuff. No Draw blocks extra draws, and Tangled increases Attack costs by 1 for the turn. - Vakuu plays your hand on one additional turn, no earlier than turn two, without Whispering Earring's energy bonus. - Confused randomizes drawn card costs for the rest of combat. Sloth applies a six-card limit per turn for the rest of combat. Dazed shuffles two Dazed into your combat draw pile. - Traps use the game's normal effects and interactions, including Artifact protection where applicable. - Filler weights now use direct per-item values: **None = 0, Low = 1, Medium = 3, High = 5**. - Combat buffs are universal; One Gold and Five Gold remain character-specific rewards. - Multiplayer buff and trap queues restore their delivery history when reconnecting or loading a campaign, preserving pending effects without replaying effects already consumed. ### Cards, relics, and rewards - Fixed **Additional Card Reward** doing nothing. It grants an actual extra three-card reward after combat in both singleplayer and multiplayer. - Fixed **Splash** having its cross-character attack choices restricted by AP character locks. - Cross-character effects, including **Kaleidoscope**, use the appropriate player’s card pools in multiplayer. Built-in character pools remain available, while modded character pools follow that player’s configured roster. - Multiplayer supports progressive starters, Ascension changes, combat buffs, and post-combat card upgrade/removal effects. - Received rewards and progression are preserved when reconnecting or loading a multiplayer campaign. ### Modded characters - **Downfall:** cross-character card pools now preserve Downfall's Prismatic Gem restrictions after Archipelago applies its configured character pools. - **IntoTheSpireverse:** shared character buttons and alternate arrows remain usable when the AP roster includes alternate characters, including rosters that omit their base-game counterparts. Selection follows the configured roster and AP character unlocks. - **Colourful Philosophers:** alternate characters sharing a base character's energy colour now display their character name, making their card pools easier to distinguish. - Added optional **`progressive_starter_card`** and **`progressive_starter_relic`** overrides for each character in Advanced Characters. Explicit true/false values override the global setting for that character; leaving a field out inherits the global setting. Both still require **Include Floor Checks**. - Per-character starter settings apply to item generation, logic, and starter upgrades in singleplayer and multiplayer, including modded characters that support the game's starter upgrade behaviour. - Added some specific handling for popular modded characters so you can add them to your yaml easier. Namely Watcher from Lamali, IntoTheSpireverse and "Downfall - Classic" characters. - Added better naming when using a 'Pre-defined modded character' such as those from the above mods so they say 'Watcher Floor 5' instead of 'Custom Character 4 Floor 5' - Allow up to 20 modded characters (up from 5 - usual modded character caveats apply), for up to 25 characters including the vanilla roster. ### YAML builder website - Added trap chance and individual trap weights under **Checks & Rewards**. - Added the new logic toggle under **Progression**. - Added per-character progressive starter card and relic controls under **Character Setup**, alongside Ascension configuration. Each can use the global setting or explicitly enable/disable it for that character. - The builder exports per-character starter fields only when an override is selected, keeping default exports free of these new fields. Starter overrides are inactive when floor checks are disabled. - Support for up to 20 modded characters, with easier entry of custom character IDs. - Generated YAMLs now include `requires` with Archipelago Launcher **0.6.7** and APWorld **1.2.0** as minimum versions, matching the template YAML. APWorld requirements use the major/minor version, so patch releases do not raise the YAML requirement. - The template YAML now includes explanations of option values and the available item options. ### Settings and interface - Added client-side overrides for **Ancient Mode** and **Ancient Pool**, allowing you to choose different Ancient settings for a new run without regenerating the multiworld. - Ancient overrides apply to new runs, including multiplayer. Continuing a saved run preserves its original settings. - Added clearer singleplayer and multiplayer entry points on the main menu. - You can disconnect and change AP slots from the main menu without restarting the game. - Improved the Ascension display to show the actual active Ascensions, including nonconsecutive combinations. - Fixed the top bar showing two bosses when AP Double Boss is inactive, in both singleplayer and multiplayer even when Ascension 10 is disabled. Boss icons and tooltips now reflect whether the second boss is enabled. - Fixed Ascension UI briefly showing Ascension 10 when starting an AP run. Multiplayer lobby displays now follow the host's AP Ascension settings. - Fixed rendering issues with the progressive campfire status icons. - Improved Universal Tracker explanations and check ordering, keeping numbered checks in a more natural order. - Added **Export Bug Report** under Archipelago Settings, with an equivalent `ap report` console command, to package multiplayer divergence reports and game logs for sharing. ### Compatibility and fixes - Fixed an IntentGraph interaction that could keep enemies at higher-Ascension damage after AP disabled Deadly Enemies. Ascension-dependent graph labels now follow AP's Deadly Enemies setting. This was a bug that only existed on the multiplayer beta branches for some unknown reasons but didn't affect the previous main release. - Restored **Python 3.11 compatibility** for the APWorld by using `typing_extensions.override` instead of the Python 3.12+ only `typing.override`. - One client package contains separate main and beta builds, with the appropriate build selected automatically. - Reduced unnecessary APWorld compatibility warnings for patch-version differences. - Fixed connection handling for missing or null slot-data values, including a case that could interrupt an otherwise successful login. - Improved APWorld slot-data compatibility and Universal Tracker restoration. - Missing or incorrectly configured modded characters produce a clear connection error instead of silently substituting their checks. - Added clearer validation for invalid character configurations. - Extensive internal cleanup and automated checks make it easier to maintain main/beta compatibility going forward.
## Known Issues/Limitations - Beta **0.111.0** is the recommended game branch and has received the most development and gameplay testing. Main **0.107.1** is included but has limited or no gameplay testing. - In multiplayer, AP menu rewards can only be claimed outside combat; Death Fragments are disabled. **Anytime** Ancient rewards are recommended. - All modded characters configured in your seed must be installed and enabled when connecting. - Older APWorlds may require a compatibility confirmation with this client. Use the updated APWorld and client together for the new traps, character aliases, expanded roster, and per-character starter settings.

entry.title: Mario Sports Mix v3.1.0
entry.content:
# Mario Sports Mix AP v3.1.0 - THE Bugfix! ## It's finally here!! Hopefully within a couple days you should see Mario Sports Mix on Ionium!! (If nothing goes wrong...) ### This release is NOT compatible with any prior 3.1.0 release...
### Breaking Changes!
- **Start With Random Sports:** Now accepts a number from `0–4` instead of on/off. Default: `4`. - **Start with Party Modes:** Now accepts `0–4` instead of on/off. Default: `0`. - Either Start With Random Sports OR Start With Party Modes must be at least 1! If not, the generator will pick a random amount of Sports OR Party Modes to start with. - **Enable Points Win (Basketball/Hockey):** Now has three options: `off`, `win_set`, and `win_round`. - **Death Link Action:** The default is now `losing_a_match`. Ties only trigger Death Link if you select `losing_or_tying_a_match`. - **Enabled Party Modes:** Now defaults to none instead of Feed Petey and Smash Skate.
### Added
#### Gameplay and Progression
- Added **Progressive Party Mode Court**, which unlocks party mode courts and songs across three tiers when Progressive Court is enabled. - You can now choose how many random sports and party modes you start with. - Added a safeguard that grants 1–4 random sports or party modes if you would otherwise start with neither. - Starting sports and party modes are limited to the number you've enabled. - Added **Win Round** for Basketball and Hockey, allowing the point target to end the entire round instead of just a set or period.
#### Client Features
- Added a settings group for configuring your game ISO and Dolphin executable. - Added automatic Dolphin launching when `auto_open` is enabled. - Check your host.yaml for both of these! - Added `/roster_fix` to fix overlapping roster characters. - Added a background roster patch that applies automatically at startup. - Added `/super_debug` to display game, boss/goal, and Death Link status. - Added the ability to skip the four sport tutorials. - Improved goal tracking across disconnects and reconnects. - Death Link health recovery for Behemoth and Behemoth King now appears as a coloured chat message. - Improved client messages when waiting for game memory or when no save file is loaded.
#### Documentation and Packaging
- Updated the README, setup guide, and known-bugs documentation. - Added an Alt Paths Guide link and Mac setup instructions. - Added a new application icon. - Updated packaging to exclude developer files from the distributed APWorld.
### Changed
#### Logic and Generation
- **Special Meter** is now a progression item regardless of Special Sanity. - Cup, alternate path, and Sports Mix entrances now correctly require their corresponding sport unlocks. - Progressive Court requirements now scale with enabled sports instead of using a fixed number of courts. - Party mode courts now use individual logic, including the new progressive tiers. - Improved validation for Special Sanity and Character Sanity settings. - Generation is now deterministic: the same seed and YAML produce consistent results. - Improved Universal Tracker compatibility. - Reorganised Harmony Hustle songs to match the new tier layout. - Renamed item groups to avoid naming conflicts.
#### Client Behaviour
- Updated game memory addresses for Behemoth HP and exhibition difficulty. - Should fix goal error! - Fixed Flower Cup bridge-toggle logic. - Improved item processing and court unlock order. - Corrected Death Link behaviour for losses, ties, and received effects. - Fixed score detection for set-based and round-based point wins. - Improved disconnect handling and Final Fantasy character unlock logic.
### Fixed
- Improved Death Link and point-based goal tracking to prevent missed or duplicated updates caused by desynchronised local state. - Fixed memory-address lookups affecting alternate paths, current nodes, rounds, cups, and sports. - Fixed errors when checking the game region before memory initialises. - Fixed errors when no save file is loaded. - Removed incorrect entries from the Harmony Hustle item table. - Fixed party mode enabled/disabled checks.

# Shovel Knight Pocket Dungeon Archipelago v1.0.0
[Setup](https://github.com/Mitchell1711/Archipelago/blob/skpd_ap/worlds/pocket_dungeon/docs/setup_en.md) | [Mod Page](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3619001702)
A major update that reworks how dungeon locations and hats are handled. This update will not be backwards compatible with 0.x versions, so make sure both the apworld and mod are on version 1! You can consider this implementation out of beta, as the APWorld has also proven to be stable over the past months and I'm much happier with the current iteration of the features. Of course, I'll still continue to work on updates!
### Changes - "Dungeon Shops" have been replaced with "Dungeon Items", instead of needing to enter Chesters relic shop during a dungeon, Archipelago units will fall down from the top of the screen. Defeat them to obtain their item! - Added an option in the .yaml that dictates how many items will fall down during a dungeon, allowing players to increase the speed of getting checks. - Removed the "shuffle hats" option, hats are instead shuffled into the itempool using the filler weights. The keyword "Hats" will shuffle hats randomly into the pool. - Added "per level" to the "hat expiration action" setting in the yaml, this is now the new default. - Added option templates, use "Generate template options" in the launcher to create them. - Chesters camp shop will now show the sprites for items from Pocket Dungeon, a selection of games have also been given custom sprites that represent their game or series. - Hats will now show a pop-up that describes what effect is currently being applied. - Give a received relic directly to the player if they're doing a run, also give a received key fragment if the player is on Scholar Sanctum. - Added a launcher icon for the client!

entry.title: Ys Origin v2.1.1
entry.content:
A patch release: the 3F barrier fix from a Hugo player's report, and a logic audit against the game's room scripts. Requires **Archipelago 0.6.7 or newer**.
> **Take all three files, and take them together.** Seeds generated with 2.1.0 stay playable with the new dll.
## 🛠️ Mod fix
- **The 3F Transfer Room now always sends you to 4F first.** Its barrier teleports Yunica and Hugo to 4F unless the Blue Necklace is worn, and that teleport is the only way into the 4F rooms. A seed can hand you the necklace early, and walking in wearing it broke the barrier for good, so 4F was out of reach. Until you have been to 4F, the barrier now ignores the necklace. - **Saves already stuck this way are repaired.** If you broke the barrier before ever reaching 4F, it comes back the next time you are in a room next to it. Walk into it to be teleported to 4F, then come back with the necklace on to break it again.
## 🗺️ Logic
Ten places where the logic counted on a check or a passage the game blocks, found by checking every room against its scripts: - six room gates, including the 6F room (wind in, dash out), the 8F dive and the 24F bridge's way back; - four story checks, including Yunica's Black Pearl, which now waits for her 19F event; - the 2F Gemma Room's two checks are Yunica's and Hugo's only (Toal cannot enter it).
## ⚠️ What was and was not played
- The barrier fix was loaded in the retail game and its check was exercised in memory for each case. The room itself was not played through. - The logic changes passed AP's integration check, 60 random seeds and 8 three-player seeds.
## 🐞 Known issues
- **Rado's Annex and story order** (from 2.1.0) is still not fixed in this dll. Hugo and Yunica can be turned around at the Rado Tower bridge by story flags from higher floors. - The known issues listed for 2.1.0 still apply.

entry.title: Look Outside v1.2.3
entry.content:
# QOL Features ### New Player options: - Various player options have been renamed and reorganized for ease of reading - Casanova Mode: sets the game to “Casanova mode”, allowing the player to kiss many of the enemies around the apartment complex. Each smooch is a location. - Include Final True Ending Equipment: When set to false, items exclusive to the Final True ending boss battle will be excluded from the item pool - Locations that are granted automatically by taking mutually exclusive actions now send in-game messages upon being granted.
## New Goal Option Changes - Completing a perfect ritual no longer counts as completing a flawed or partial ritual for goal purposes - XIN-AMON and Eternal fate endings still count as Flawed Ritual endings - Failed Ritual (zero correct offerings) is now differentiated from Flawed Ritual, and Mask Ending counts as a Failed Ritual - Overhauled “Goal” player option to be a set of goals that the player can mix and match - "Failed Ritual": Go to the roof without giving the astronomers any correct offerings - "Flawed Ritual": Give the astronomers at least one correct offering and defeat them on the roof - "Perfect Ritual": Give the astronomers all four correct offerings and defeat them on the roof - "Screaming Sky Ending": Give the astronomers all four correct offerings and flee from their final form on the roof - "Promise Ending": Give the astronomers all four correct offerings and defeat them on the roof after making a promise to Sybil - "Mask Ending": Give the astronomers all four weird offerings and face the Masked Shadow on the roof - "XIN-AMON Ending": Give three correct offerings and a Guinea Pig to Beryl, and then defeat XIN-AMON on the roof - "Eternal Fate Ending" - Give the Guinea Pig as any offering and face it on the roof - "Unity Ending" - Kill Sybil and enter the red door in the observatory to learn the truth - "Final True Ending" - Give the astronomers all four correct offerings, defeat them on the roof, then unleash the true power of your Meteor Strike! - "Words of Power Ending" - Complete all crosswords for the secret key, then accept Wilhelmina’s offer in the Tomb of Crosswords - “Smooch the Sultan” - Power up by kissing 49 or more enemies and then give the Sultan of Kissing a kiss (selecting this goal activates Casanova Mode + locations) - "Smooch The Visitor" - Give the astronomers all four correct offerings, defeat them on the roof, then give the Visitor a kiss :3. (selecting this goal activates Casanova Mode + locations)
# Client Changes - Removed ._DS_Store artifacts from zip file - Fixed bug where item name was not displayed and location was not rewarded for "Apt. 12 Walls Large Room - Item on East Table" - Fixed bug where the randomized item at location "Apt. 12 Planetarium - Item in North Closet" replaced the exit door instead of the intended item. - Fixed bug where item grant message would not be sent for “Landlord Hell South Hall - Slay Gatling” - Fixed bug where “Fungus Maze Depths - Spore Guardian Audrey Loot” would not be correctly rewarded upon defeating the Spore Guardian with Audrey already in your party - Fixed some missing or swapped item icons - Added missing text for “Ease Regrets” option that revives Spine - Added “Ease Regrets” option that revives the Minesweeper - Removed trigger that permanently disables the blackout event when walking through the door to the roof - Removed vanilla “Custom Gun” drop from Nestored Eugene - Fixed bug where Elevator Freak would die upon player running away from combat - Also removed vanilla game behavior where player would be transferred to the basement floor upon running away from the Elevator Freak - Fixed bug where the incorrect variable was being tracked to check whether or not Colonel Squeakums had been killed for both Ernest’s “Ease Regrets” option and the location "Ernest's Hideout - Slay Colonel Squeakums"
# Apworld Changes - Cleaned up print statement that was sending out irrelevant info during world generation - “Apt. 28 Twilight - Slay Piranha Guy” is no longer considered a Friendly Fire location as Piranha Guy dies no matter what the player does - Fixed logic bug where the game assumed players were able to enter stairwell from ground floor before placing any planet discs in the stairwell sockets - Fixed logic bug where Basement Key wasn’t considered a requirement to reach Apt. 25 (Dan’s Apartment) - Fixed logic bug where game assumed players didn’t need any extra herbicide to traverse inner Apartment 12 - Fixed logic bug where “Audrey” was not considered a required item for some Audrey Loot locations - Fixed logic bug where “Guinea Pig” was not considered a required item for "Security Room - Slay Cinnamon" - Fixed logic bug where the ability to face Garbage Worm on ground floor was not considered a requirement for “Basement Utility Room - Item Dropped by Garbage Worm” - Removed glitch world keys from the item pool when mask offering areas are disabled in settings - Fixed logic bug where only two “yellow key” items were considered necessary to traverse glitch world, when the game requires three. A third key will also be added to the item pool in seeds that include glitch world locations. - Fixed other glitch key counts that were larger than the amount of corresponding locks; the item pool now only contains as many glitch world keys as there are glitch world locks - Landlord Hell East - Slay Gatling is now assigned to the correct Landlord apartment phase in logic - Updated locations and removed duplicate locations corresponding to slaying the Basilisk in Meat World Eyeball and picking up the item where the Ocular Tetherblade would be in vanilla - Split singular locations for enemies fought in a group into multiple in cases where the vanilla game has separate variables tracking whether they have been killed - In the locked room of Vincent’s apartment: “Apt. 37 Locked Room - Slay Eye Monsters” has been split into "Apt. 37 Locked Room - Slay Eye Legs", "Apt. 37 Locked Room - Slay Eye Shoulder", and "Apt. 37 Locked Room - Slay Wiggle Eye" - Because of this, Eye Shoulder is now fightable on all difficulties - In the west bedroom of Vincent’s apartment: "Apt. 37 Bedroom - Slay Onlookers" has been split into "Apt. 37 Bedroom - Slay Onlooker 1" and "Apt. 37 Bedroom - Slay Onlooker 2" - Other new locations: - “Eugene's Shop - Gift From Nestor's Head” (Gift given upon interacting with a freshly Nestored Eugene) - “Fred's Apt. - Gift from Fred” (gift given upon first speaking to the fake Fred/facetaker)

entry.title: Civilization IV v0.0.1r3
entry.content:
It's time for some new features! The main things are adding Unique Units and Unique Buildings to the itempool. I've also made an "AP World" Civilization with no UU/UB/starting techs as part of the eventual "blank slate" I want (though adding traits to the itempool appears to be much harder than I thought). This is very much a first draft of the feature (especially UBs), so make sure to read the notes before using them.
### Changelog: - Added options to add Unique Units and Unique Buildings to the itempool. The way it works is to randomly add as many as it can as "useful" items. - Added an AP World Civilization, so you can properly use Unique Building items and not break logic with starting techs--it's meant to be used with unrestricted leaders, and I'm also not sure if the AI can roll into that Civ randomly (something I want to change if it can). - Fixed a typo that caused the Great Spy item to spawn a regular spy instead.
### Installation Instructions: 1. Unzip Civ4-Archipelago-Mod into your Beyond the Sword mod folder (I've been testing it in the My Games one, but theoretically it should also work in the installation folder one; let me know if one or both work or don't work!), make sure the structure is Beyond the Sword/Mods/Civ4-Archipelago-Mod and that there isn't an extra folder in that structure. 2. Install the APWorld as normal.
### Play Instructions: 1. Run the Civilization IV client from Archipelago, but **do not connect from the client**; you'll do so in-game (and eventually I want to remove the ability to connect from the client) 2. Start a new Civ4 Beyond the Sword game as normal--**I highly recommend playing in windowed mode**, since this is an alpha and if the game freezes it can be difficult/impossible to close out of it if it's in full screen mode. 3. When you load in you'll get a popup saying to connect to the Archipelago Server: you do this by opening up the BUG options (the little dragon in the upper-right corner), entering in your information, then clicking "Save and Connect." If the connection is successful you'll get a popup that says "Successfully Connected," and you can play as normal. If you get an error, try connecting again, it most often means you don't have the client open or you're already connected in the client. Occasionally however the connection will be slow and you connect in the client but get an error in-game; in that case disconnect in the client and try again. **If this happens a lot to you let me know!**
### Gameplay Issues: 1. You can still receive techs in Techsanity from some ways that aren't traditional research: starting techs from your leader and tech trading, and this could lead to duplicates. These are planned to be removed in future updates. Let me know if things break because of them--they shouldn't, but I'm not 100% certain. 2. The settings aren't balanced at all, and it may make you do things like get 9 Great Scientists when all you have is the library or research Satellites before you have any economic techs. The Techsanity Era Gates setting should help the latter, and I'd highly recommend against large GPsanity numbers unless you have a lot of time to kill (though the added Great People in the pool will help). 3. There are a lot of debugging messages left in the mod. I removed some of them, but don't expect a clean feed. 4. When you're trying to select an "obsolete" wonder to build in the city screen, the building options will jump to the top of the building list due to the hacky way I've implemented that ability. I want to fix it eventually, but for now the easiest way to mitigate it is to use the wonder filter on the right side of the city list (the star), which will have it jump back to the start of the wonders, which hopefully won't make it jump. You can also use the "choose what to build next" dialog, or just select it without moving your mouse (use the scroll wheel). 5. The "AP" Unique Units can't be upgraded into, though they can be upgraded themselves. This is planned to be fixed in an upcoming update. 6. AP Unique Buildings are programmed assuming you don't have a "natural" Unique Building for your Civilization for purposes like avoiding duplicates of the same class of building, so if you use a Civilization other than AP World things could break. 7. If a building has a requirement to be built (such as the University), and you build an AP Unique Building version of it (such as the Seowon), you aren't able to build the original version anymore. There's no reason why you'd need to do this (the only vanilla building that's not strictly worse than the UB alternatives is the Theatre/Hippodrome, and that doesn't suffer the bug), but it's weird behavior.
### Technical Issues: 1. I had generation errors when creating solo/near-solo multiworlds with high Techsanity Era Gates values--I never tested with higher values with locations other than Techsanity enabled but keep that in mind if you're having trouble generating. 2. Whenever you close and reopen the game/a save file, you need to disconnect the client, and you should close and reopen the client to avoid missing checks. I plan to try and automate this in future updates. 3. There have been bug reports of items received/obtained while offline not properly appearing in-game and/or being sent to the multiworld when reconnecting. I think this is related to mismatching either mod or APworld versions, but I haven't fully found the root cause yet. 4. If you add Unique Buildings to the itempool, it causes a noticeable amount of lag when entering the city screen in some cases (due to the coding I need to make them work how I want them to). I think it scales with the amount of cities you have, but it also might be just a memory leak. If you experience this lag (or don't and think you would), let me know!
If you have any questions, bug reports, or things I forgot to mention, let me know in [the Civilization IV thread in the Archipelago Discord server](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1326231506682904576).
Github for the APWorld: https://github.com/VincentBorchardt/Archipelago/blob/main/worlds/civ_4/
